text:
anya: Kicked off canary rollout for release v3.0.0-rc1 to pool-canary-1 at 03:07 UTC. Requesting quick smoke-run (small) across kv-prefill, http-heartbeat, embed-synth, and reranker-sanity. tagging @deploy-bot to run.

deploy-bot: running smoke-suite --profile canary-small --probes kv-prefill,http-heartbeat,embed-synth,reranker-sanity. ETA ~3m. Posting results here.

rahul: Quick decision rubric: fail if embed-synth p95 > 200ms OR reranker-sanity > 0.7 error rate OR sustained 5xx > 0.3% for >90s. Otherwise let canary run for 15m and collect extended traces.

sre-oncall: early telemetry looks fine for kv-prefill + heartbeat but embed-synth tail in apac2 showing p95 ~255ms and sporadic 502s. Routing looks normal; infra capacity in apac2 at 78%. Raising a low-priority alert.

deploy-bot: smoke-suite summary:
- kv-prefill: OK (p95 38ms)
- http-heartbeat: OK (no 5xx)
- reranker-sanity: OK (error rate 0.12%)
- embed-synth: ANOMALY (apac2) p95=261ms, 5xx=0.6%
Marking canary pool status: PARTIAL_FAIL (apac2).

anya: Hmm. Not ideal. Options: 1) rollback apac2 only, 2) pin apac2 to previous stable, 3) throttle traffic to apac2 and continue global canary. Thoughts?

katie: We should avoid full rollback if other regions are green. Prefer to isolate apac2 and pin to v2.9.7 (last stable). Also capture a snapshot of the quant config and kernel selection for that pod.

rahul: Agreed. Plan: pin apac2 to v2.9.7, initiate a targeted rollback for pool apac2, run an extended embed-synth sweep (5m) in apac2, and add a temporary alert for p95 jumps >50ms within 2m. I'll run commands.

# commands
```
/deploy pin inference --region apac2 --to-version v2.9.7 --reason "embed-synth tail in apac2"
/deploy rollback inference --region apac2 --to-version v2.9.7 --reason "targeted rollback after embed-synth anomaly"
```

deploy-bot: Pin + targeted rollback kicked off by rahul at 03:10 UTC. Rolling back apac2 pool -> v2.9.7. ETA ~55s. Will auto-run post-rollback probes in apac2 (embed-synth extended 5m).

sre-oncall: Created INC-2026-512: embed-synth-apac2-tail. Collecting traces, kernel-selection logs, and quant-profile dump. Also validating network egress paths.

anya: After rollback completes, re-run smoke-suite globally and the extended apac2 embed sweep. If apac2 still fails, we'll pause the staggered rollout and open a feature-flag rollback in the build. Also add an entry to release notes: "Targeted rollback in apac2 after embed-synth tail spike; global rollout continues."

deploy-bot: Post-rollback apac2 probes: embed-synth p95=44ms, 5xx=0.0%. apac2 status: PASS. Global quick smoke re-run: all probes OK. Canary overall: PASS (with apac2 pinned to v2.9.7).

katie: Adding timeline note to the release changelog and tagging ml-eng for quant/profile follow-up. Also creating a short runbook item to check kernel selection mismatch on mixed gen GPU hosts.

rahul: Follow-ups: 1) reproduce with quant profile locally against apac2 config, 2) run extended canary with traffic ramp disabled for 30m, 3) consider reverting the quant toggle in the RC and re-evaluate perf.

anya: Thanks. Leaving thread open for attached traces and final postmortem summary. :white_check_mark:
